title: Mask and Play
strapline: An immersive exploration of mask work and theatrical play on the island of Corsica.
summary: Mask and Play brings together various mask traditions -- from Neutral to Expressive -- in an intensive format surrounded by the landscape of Corsica. The workshop explores how the mask liberates the performer's body and imagination.
lead: A unique opportunity to work with masks in an inspiring Mediterranean setting, combining rigorous physical training with the freedom of play.
audience: Performers wanting an immersive mask experience in a unique setting
Theatre-makers exploring the relationship between mask, body, and environment
International practitioners seeking intensive training outside the studio
outcomes: Experience across multiple mask traditions and their physical demands
Deeper understanding of how environment and space shape theatrical play
Skills in mask-based improvisation and ensemble creation

schedule.label: Morning body work
schedule.detail: Physical preparation attuned to the natural environment -- breath, rhythm, and spatial awareness.

schedule.label: Mask explorations
schedule.detail: Working through different mask families with exercises designed for discovery and play.

schedule.label: Evening ensemble
schedule.detail: Collective creation sessions where the day's explorations become shared theatrical moments.

focusAreas: Mask forms and their physical language
Creative exploration through mask and movement
moduleDescription: A workshop exploring the intersection of mask forms and physical play. Performers develop clarity, boldness, and a responsive physical language through guided creative exploration.
